script_system.script_relationship: Chinese owns the central identity, formal support and handwritten voice; Latin creates top claim cadence and secondary naming without replacing the Chinese first read.
script_system.type_family_behavior: A custom block-like white display mass is contrasted with clean geometric Latin, restrained functional Chinese, and an orange handwritten slogan.
script_system.language_hierarchy: Chinese central title first; top claims, badge, support line and slogan form secondary/tertiary reads; footer lockup closes the page.

title_architecture.statement: The central white 山野集 title spans most of the middle width as an irregular silhouette; it is not a conventional line of uniform glyphs and it occupies the photographic foliage rather than a separate text panel.
title_architecture.uncertainty: The exact source lettering construction method and font ancestry are unknown.

glyph_mechanisms.statement: The title uses mountain/stone-like block masses, uneven character scale, carved negative-space cuts, eroded white surfaces and selective missing-stroke geometry to turn the four glyphs into one landscape-like object.
glyph_mechanisms.uncertainty: Exact glyph outlines are brand-bound and must not be traced or treated as a reusable font.

hierarchy_mechanisms.statement: The first read is the central white title; the second read combines the four top English claim groups, orange badge and restrained Chinese support; the third read is the handwritten slogan and bottom WANCE lockup.
hierarchy_mechanisms.uncertainty: Exact claim count and copy are content/production bound.

layout_coupling.statement: A thin orange thread loops through and around the title, visually connects the badge and display mass, and is echoed by the handwritten slogan; it behaves as a semantic path rather than an unrelated border.

evidence_pointer.region: central title, left badge, and lower slogan

layout_coupling.uncertainty: The intended semantic narrative of the path is not stated in metadata.

color_material_binding.statement: High-mass white title, limited orange accents and quieter beige support text remain legible against a deep green, spatially complex photographic forest background; contrast roles—not exact color values—organize the type layers.
color_material_binding.uncertainty: Exact green, white, orange, and beige values are production bound.

failure_modes.statement: Replacing the central lettering with a stock bold CJK font, using orange as a generic underline, or removing the claim/footer hierarchy would preserve copy but lose the evidence-backed visual system.
failure_modes.uncertainty: Transfer behavior remains untested and pending human distillation review.

failure_modes.statement: The bottom WANCE lockup and edge labels are production/brand-bound alignment evidence, not permission to reuse the brand identity.

figma_producibility.rationale: The central title needs the approved display-lettering source pipeline; Figma may not invent it zero-to-one.
